title: A new class action lawsuit questions whether Anthropic broke the law by misleading power users
summary: Anthropic says power users are key to its business - it's prioritized them even when it means cutting off other popular applications, like OpenClaw. But some of these same customers say Anthropic misled them into believing they'd get more out of a top-tier pricing subscription than they did.
